caption: From under the clear sea, the underside of a boat shows as a wavering dark shape through the surface.

sa.check: The view is from under the sea.
The underside of a boat shows as a wavering shape through the surface.

pc.expect: The shape is the boat's hull, dark against the sky, and steadies when the water is calm.
pc.fail: It is a different object; or it is sharp on a plainly rippled surface; or it never steadies on calm water.

pc.expect: The shape is visible through the surface and its edges ripple with it.
pc.fail: The surface is opaque; or the edges are rigid while the surface ripples; or the shape ripples on a flat calm.

pc.expect: The hull sits at the surface, not below the viewer.
pc.fail: The hull is below; or it rises out of sight; or it sinks.

pc.expect: The surface is liquid: ripples pass and fade.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or ripples freeze; or the water leaps.
A second hull appears; or the boat vanishes; or the water becomes solid.

pc.expect: The water's colour and the hull stay the same.
pc.fail: The water changes colour; or the hull changes; or the light changes abruptly.
